_comment: Deliberately illegal fixture for run-flow.sh's DRC negative control
(issue #122, updated by #149): two 2.0 x 2.0 um nwell islands 0.50 um
apart -- below sky130's nwell.2a minimum spacing (1.27 um) -- plus a
0.60 um wide nwell stripe, below nwell.1's minimum width (0.84 um).
Exactly the failure mode a deliberately-split well risks: two nwell
shapes drawn just barely apart are not two wells, they are one merged
well on silicon.
Run through `klt drc --deck sky130` directly (curated engine, no
standalone `klayout` binary needed) since klt 0.4.0
(2AMLogic/klayout-tools#1420): the curated sky130 deck reports
'nwell.space.1'/'nwell.width.1' violations on these shapes. klt 0.3.0's
curated deck carried no n-well rules at all and reported this same
fixture 'clean' -- see ../README.md's verdict table for the closed gap
this fixture used to demonstrate.
Before #149, this fixture also carried a `tap` (65/44) coincident with
its nwell (0 um enclosure, testing difftap.10) and a `diff` (65/20)
coincident with its nwell (0 um enclosure, testing difftap.8), checked
through a hand-written DRC-DSL deck (`drc/nwell_isolation.drc`, retired
by #149) run via `klt drc --engine klayout --deck-file`, which shells
out to a standalone `klayout` binary. Those two defects are dropped
here rather than carried forward unused: klt 0.4.0's curated deck
deliberately does not transcribe difftap.8/difftap.10 (they are
implant-scoped -- `and(nsdm)`/`and(psdm)` in sky130's own deck -- and no
`klt gen` generator in this repo's flows draws psdm/nsdm), and this
environment has no working `klayout` binary to check them any other
way. See ../README.md's 'The DRC gap this recipe used to work around'
section for the full writeup and the open klayout-tools issue if that
coverage is ever worth restoring.
Written with `klt draw`, which writes geometry verbatim with no rule
checking -- exactly what a DRC negative control needs, the same way
layout/bin/drc_violation_fixture.json is the negative control for the
trivial-cell flow's curated-deck verdict.
